highball.name: Highball
highball.description: A highball is a type of mixed drink that consists of a base spirit and a larger proportion of a non-alcoholic mixer, served over ice in a tall glass.

sour.name: Sour
sour.description: A sour is a type of mixed drink that consists of a base spirit, a sweet component, and a sour component, typically served over ice.

ancestral.name: Ancestral
ancestral.description: An ancestral cocktail is a type of mixed drink that combines a base spirit with a sweet component and a sour component, often served in a shot glass.

split.name: Split
split.description: A split cocktail is a type of mixed drink that consists of a base spirit and a sweet component, typically served in a shot glass.
